        scan.nextLine();
        String s = scan.nextLine();

            if (s.charAt(i) == '(') {

                parenContents.add(s.substring(lastOpen + 1, i));

        int n = scan.nextInt();
        scan.nextLine();
        String s = scan.nextLine();
        
        // Extract parenthetical content using regex
        List<String> parenContents = new ArrayList<>();
        int start = 0;
        while ((start = s.indexOf('(', start)) != -1) {
            int end = s.indexOf(')', start);
            if (end != -1) {
                parenContents.add(s.substring(start + 1, end));
                start = end + 1;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        
        // Use streams to compute max length and count
        int[] result = parenContents.stream()
            .flatMap(content -> Arrays.stream(content.split("_")))
            .filter(word -> !word.isEmpty())
            .mapToInt(String::length)
            .reduce(new int[]{0, 0}, 
                (acc, len) -> { acc[0] = Math.max(acc[0], len); acc[1]++; return acc; },
                (acc1, acc2) -> { acc1[0] = Math.max(acc1[0], acc2[0]); acc1[1] += acc2[1]; return acc1; });
        
        System.out.println(result[0] + " " + result[1]);
    }
}
